The era split reports the coefficient before 2025Q1, the shift at the reasoning-model inflection, and the coefficient from 2025Q1 on. Log outcomes and shares are multiplied by 100; hours are in hours. Each panel is one regression per outcome on occupation-by-group-by-quarter cells, weighted by the group's 2019 employment in the occupation, with occupation-by-group and quarter-by-group fixed effects and the exposure terms interacted with group indicators; the group coefficients are the sums of the base terms and the interactions. $R^{2}$, the outcome mean, and $N$ refer to the pooled regression of the panel. \textsuperscript{*}$p<0.10$, \textsuperscript{**}$p<0.05$, \textsuperscript{***}$p<0.01$.
